label: Armour tier list: robes, clothes and cloth

items.verdict: monk-only; Kushigo Counter needs Patient Defense, the weakest monk bonus action
wrath stacking needs you to be hit; build-around, and dead for unarmed monks
+2 Dexterity is the strongest effect on the list; initiative, AC and damage in one
+1 AC, fire and cold resistance; REQUIRES AN UNUSUAL STORY CHOICE, MANY RUNS NEVER SEE IT
extra 1d4 poison only, and almost no spells deal poison damage
earliest chest slot +1 spell save DC; best in slot for casters through acts 1-2
+2 spell damage but only when hit by melee; realistically abjuration wizards only
+2 Constitution; rated on that alone because RUIN TAMER HEART IS FULLY BUGGED
free Armour of Agathys once per rest; cast it then swap the robe off
+2 Strength, but strength elixirs eat its role unless you house-rule them out
+1 all saves and advantage on Con saves; best purely defensive act 2 robe
swap-in for known fire encounters; fire resistance is easier to get elsewhere
+1 AC, Charisma damage per cantrip beam and temp HP; best in slot for warlocks
+1 save DC, but the Sparkswall strictly dominates it and arrives far earlier
temp HP, flat damage reduction and retaliation; best on abjuration wizards
broken duplicate of the Bloodguzzler Garb found in act 3; possibly cut content
+1 AC, insight advantage and fear immunity; a bundle of mid effects
Con save advantage only while drunk; strictly worse than the Moon Devotion Robe

items.item: Garb of the Land and Sky
items.verdict: +1 AC and Step of the Wind damage; BUGGED to persist on unarmed attacks, still A unbugged
+1 attack and damage plus +1 AC, but only while shapeshifted or disguised
+1 save DC, +1 spell attack and +2 AC; strict upgrade for act 3 spellcasters
adds spell mod to all saves while concentrating, but defence is cheap by act 3
save advantage against spells plus a Mirror Image cast not worth the swapping
anti-undead defence barely beats plain AC, even in the fights it targets
+2 AC best in slot for monks, but S BY DEFAULT with no real competition
the Graceful Cloth does everything it does far better and much earlier
fire and cold resistance, water healing, +1 AC and a big Create Water

unassigned.why: Robe of Summer gets a full discussion and a scathing write-off but is never given a letter
